text_en: Liandris, we have been made aware of some unusual beings recently appearing across Terragaya.
I am aware of the phenomenon that has brought them to Terragaya but these beings are not our concern at this moment.
They were “cut off” inside that dome, which is why we appeared.
Have I not made it clear that I have no interest in the Humans? I speak of the other soulless beings.
No... for now, be cautious, but watch them closely.
